headings.instruction: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all headings. Never center headings unless for a specific visual balance reason. Use font-black for maximum impact on primary screen titles.

body.instruction: Use Satoshi for body copy. Maintain leading-relaxed for readable descriptions.

mono.instruction: Use for Issue IDs, coordinates, and timestamps to give a technical/administrative feel.

colors.instruction: Strict adherence to high contrast. No generic full-screen gradients. Map elements must pop against the base gray/white UI. Do not use pure #000000, use #09090B. Ensure 4.5:1 contrast for all text.

surfaces.glassmorphism: Use 'backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border border-white/20 shadow-sm' for floating map controls (filter chips, locate me button, header). Never use 100% transparent backgrounds over the map.
surfaces.neumorphism: Not applicable for this context. Stick to sharp, flat cards.
surfaces.borders: 1px solid #E4E4E7 for structural elements. 2px solid #09090B for active states.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons must be solid #09090B with white text. Apply hover states with slight opacity changes or translation (-translate-y-0.5).
components.inputs: Shadcn/UI customized. Solid backgrounds (bg-gray-100), no borders by default, 2px ring on focus (ring-black).
components.map_markers: Minimum 44x44px touch targets. Colored by category. Use distinct SVGs/icons inside markers, not just dots.
components.bottom_sheet: Use Vaul/Drawer for 'Report Issue' wizard and 'Issue Details'. Must have a drag handle (w-12 h-1.5 bg-gray-300 rounded-full).
components.filter_chips: Horizontal scrollable list. Glassmorphic background when floating over map. Selected state uses solid black background.
components.admin_table: Dense padding (p-2). Sentence case headers. Status dots (6px) next to labels. Use IBM Plex Mono for Issue IDs.
components.instruction: Customize Shadcn/UI heavily. Do not use default Vercel-like borders. Override tablist height with 'h-auto'.

grids_and_layouts.mobile_map: Full viewport (h-screen w-screen). Floating UI elements must be positioned absolute with generous padding (p-4 to p-6) from screen edges to avoid safe areas.
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar 240px width. Main content area uses 12-column grid. Grid gaps must be tight (gap-4 or gap-6).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Use p-6 or p-8 for modal/drawer interiors. Avoid cramped content. Always add bottom padding (pb-24) to lists so the floating CTA doesn't cover content.

motion.transitions: Use 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease'. NEVER use 'transition: all'.
motion.stagger: List items in 'My Issues' and Admin table must stagger in.
motion.bottom_sheet: Smooth slide-up animation. Ensure 'prefers-reduced-motion' is respected.

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44x44px for all map markers, filter chips, and icon buttons.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-black).
accessibility.test_ids: All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'report-issue-fab', 'category-filter-chip', 'submit-report-button').

garbage.description: Bags of garbage line a building along a street

libraries.icons: lucide-react (Standard clean UI) and @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone map markers)

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: leaflet, react-leaflet, vaul, framer-motion, sonner, @phosphor-icons/react
Generate pages for Citizen App (Map Home, Report Wizard, Issue Detail, My Issues) and Admin Dashboard (/admin).
Citizen App MUST be mobile-first. Use full-screen height (h-[100dvh]) to account for mobile browser chrome.
Implement the Report Issue wizard as a Vaul bottom sheet or multi-step modal.
Implement a robust 'data-testid' strategy across all actionable components.
Map UI must feel deeply integrated, not like an iframe. Float controls over the map with glassmorphic backgrounds.
DO NOT add any login or sign-up screens. The system is entirely open access as per user requirements.
Reverse geocoding can be mocked initially but structure the UI to show a 'Locating...' state followed by a plain text address confirmation.
For the admin dashboard, implement the North Star Metric (e.g., 'Total Open Issues') in the top left, followed by a dense data table for issue management.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all').
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use placeholder URLs for images.
